# Hook-script fixtures (11 §A.3, §A.5.1, §A.6)

One file per script shape the classifier must recognise (`crates/snp-git/tests/behaviour/hookscripts.rs`):

| File | Shape | Expected class |
|---|---|---|
| `pre-commit-era3`, `pre-commit-era3-windows` | pre-commit ≥ 2.16 bash template (`resources/hook-tmpl`, verbatim at 4.6.2; the Windows variant has `#!/bin/sh` first) | `PreCommit { era: Some(3) }` |
| `pre-commit-era2` | pre-commit 2.0–2.15 Python template (`ARGS = [...]`; reconstructed from 11 §A.3) | `PreCommit { era: Some(2) }` |
| `pre-commit-era1` | pre-commit 1.x Python template (`ID_HASH`, `HOOK_TYPE = …`; reconstructed) | `PreCommit { era: Some(1) }` |
| `pre-commit-prior-<hash>` | pre-2018 bash templates carrying one of the five `PRIOR_HASHES` (reconstructed) | `PreCommit { era: None }` |
| `prek` | prek's `HOOK_TMPL` rendered (`prek/crates/prek/src/cli/install.rs`) | `Prek` |
| `lefthook` | lefthook's `hook.tmpl` rendered (`internal/templates/hook.tmpl`) | `Lefthook` |
| `snp-v1` | an snp 1.x script (`# Generated by SNP (Shell Not Pass)`; reconstructed) | `SnpV1` |
| `snp-current` | the snp 2.x template of 11 §A.6 | `Snp { stale: false }` |

The reconstructed files keep every byte the classifier looks at (the ids, `ARGS=(`, `ARGS = [`, `HOOK_TYPE = `,
`Generated by SNP`, `LEFTHOOK`); the rest is representative of the era.
